items.title: Being finite is fpqc local on the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that finiteness is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6318-6322). The proof displays the equivalence it uses -- a morphism is finite exactly when it is integral and locally of finite type -- and combines the two corresponding descent lemmas (proof lines 6324-6330). The level is H2: the decomposition is written out and both ingredients are matched to their lemmas.
